episodes.title: Plan B
episodes.summary: A condom mishap and a kid's birthday party prompt Dev to consider the reality of having children.

episodes.title: Parents
episodes.summary: First-generationers Dev and Brian try to show their appreciation for their immigrant parents at a joint family dinner.

episodes.title: Hot Ticket
episodes.summary: Dev's plan to score a date with a pretty waitress by inviting her to a concert doesn't have quite the result he wanted.

episodes.title: Indians on TV
episodes.summary: Dev has a series of eye-opening experiences after he encounters some casual racism in TV auditions.

episodes.title: The Other Man
episodes.summary: Dev has the chance to hook up with a woman he meets at a party, but the opportunity comes with a few complications.

episodes.title: Nashville
episodes.summary: For his first official date with Rachel, Dev decides to go big and take her to Nashville for the weekend.

episodes.title: Ladies and Gentlemen
episodes.summary: Rachel and Denise school Dev and Arnold about the difficulties of being a woman in a world of creepy dudes. Dev is inspired to embrace feminism.

episodes.title: Old People
episodes.summary: An unexpected death inspires Dev and Rachel to visit Rachel's grandmother, while Arnold contends with a strange inheritance.

episodes.title: Mornings
episodes.summary: Dev and Rachel discover that living together isn't always going to be a series of happy mornings free from conflict and dirty clothes on the floor.

episodes.title: Finale
episodes.summary: After attending a wedding and a movie premiere, Dev and Rachel have to face up to all kinds of issues between them.

episodes.title: The Thief
episodes.summary: While studying pasta making in Italy, Dev makes a serendipitous connection on his birthday, only to have his plans upended by a thief.

episodes.title: Le Nozze
episodes.summary: Arnold stops by on his way to a wedding to explore Modena with his Little Bud. But he hasn't told Dev the whole truth about his trip.

episodes.title: Religion
episodes.summary: Back in New York, a visit from observant Muslim relatives puts Dev in a tricky position. He introduces his cousin to a forbidden pleasure: pork.

episodes.title: First Date
episodes.summary: Sucked into a popular dating app, Dev winds up on a string of awkward, fun and disorienting dates with very different women.

episodes.title: The Dinner Party
episodes.summary: After welcoming the Jabbawockeez to his show, Dev struggles to find the right date to take to a dinner party thrown by his celebrity chef boss.

episodes.title: New York, I Love You
episodes.summary: As Dev and friends head to a theater to see the hit movie "Death Castle," the lives of several ordinary New Yorkers intersect in subtle ways.

episodes.title: Door #3
episodes.summary: A sweet job offer forces Dev to take stock of his priorities. Brian helps his dad with a romantic dilemma. A cupcake competition judge gets cold feet.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.summary: Over a series of Thanksgivings from the '90s to the present, Denise settles into her sexuality and faces the challenge of coming out to her family.

episodes.title: Amarsi Un Po
episodes.summary: When Francesca returns to New York for a month, Dev plays tour guide and finds himself caught in a whirlwind of confusing emotions.

episodes.title: Buona Notte
episodes.summary: Just as Dev's personal life reaches a tipping point, disturbing revelations throw his professional life into turmoil, too.

episodes.title: Moments in Love, Chapter 1
episodes.summary: Now a bestselling author, Denise leads a quiet life with her wife, Alicia, in upstate New York. But dinner with another couple leads to bigger questions.

episodes.title: Moments in Love, Chapter 2
episodes.summary: As the mood in the house grows more strained, Alicia leaves town for an antique fair.

episodes.title: Moments in Love, Chapter 3
episodes.summary: Facing a wave of major changes in her life, Denise wrestles with feelings of guilt and failure.

episodes.title: Moments in Love, Chapter 4
episodes.summary: Alicia turns to a fertility clinic for help and soon finds herself on a physical, financial and emotional odyssey.

episodes.title: Moments in Love, Chapter 5
episodes.summary: A trip upstate leads to reflections on the past and present.
